selection: For each pair/arm, deduplicate exact case+focus+target across arms, then select round-robin salted-hash minima across source-frequency quartile, focus cost1/2-3/4-8, expanded-vs-minimal-vs-head and alternative-count1/multiple strata. Prefer one selected focus per case within each arm. If a cell lacks8 unique scopes, record shortage and fill from remaining salted candidates round-robin pair/arm, preserving origin. Selection never uses a semantic verdict. All uncensored rows retained.
context: Exact full BST source and all preceding dialogue turns retained for review only; no prior dialogue used at matching runtime.
limitations: Reused TRAIN; corpus proposal surfaces and some source examples may be familiar. This is independent contextual labeling, not new unseen population evidence.
